images.caption: Figure 1:Motivation and performances of LT-OPD. Left: different visual token reduction methods all fail to perform well under an extremely low budget. Middle: Under this scenario, predictive distribution mismatch caused by fixed-prefix methods can lead to the wrong answer. LT-OPD, however, leverages on-policy learning to mitigate the problem. “dist.” means distribution and “student prefix” means prefix generated by students. Right: Compared with HiPrune (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%), and EPIC (5%), our LT-OPD reaches the best trade-off.

Figure 2:Framework of LT-OPD, consisting of two parts. First, an on-policy self-distillation algorithm is proposed to train a low-token student, with a full-token frozen self-teacher. “dist.” means distribution. Second, we design a budget-level curriculum learning process for stable training.
